A café on Venizelou

Localito Specialty Coffee is at Eleftheriou Venizelou 76 in Paphos, under a white sign with the colourful ram. Inside there are wooden tables, lounge chairs, plants and a shelf with coffee equipment. It is the second Localito, larger than the first, and it opens at 6:30 on weekdays.

What guests say

Three of 130 Google reviews, 123 of them with five stars.
